map.→ 打开公摊面积详细核算（含各部位）工具: -> Open the detailed shared area calculation tool (by part)
map.业委会要求公开各部位面积来源，逐项核对: The homeowners committee requires the source of each area to be disclosed, so check item by item
map.公摊 = 建筑面积 − 套内面积: Shared area = gross floor area - internal floor area
map.公摊面积详细核算工具按部位（电梯、走廊、大堂等）逐项计算公摊面积与分摊系数，适合: The detailed shared area calculation tool computes the shared area and allocation coefficient part by part (lifts, corridors, lobbies and so on), suitable for verifying the area of a property and checking the owners right to know.
map.公摊面积详细核算（含各部位） 使用指南: Detailed shared area calculation (by part) guide
map.哪个部位最影响公摊？: Which part affects the shared area most?
map.检查是否漏录部位或套内面积口径不一致，逐项加总应与测绘总公摊相等，差额为录入错误: Check whether any part was missed or the internal area figures use a different basis; the item-by-item total should equal the surveyed total shared area, and any difference is an entry error.
map.物业将公摊按电梯井、楼梯、大堂、管道井等逐部位录入，核算各部位占比: The property enters the shared area part by part - lift shafts, stairs, lobbies, pipe shafts and so on - and calculates the share of each part
map.老旧小区改造后重新测绘，对比改造前后各部位公摊变化: Re-survey after renovating an old residential compound and compare the shared area of each part before and after
map.部位明细和总公摊对不上怎么办？: What if the part breakdown does not match the total shared area?
map.高层电梯井与设备层通常占比最高；核对时应优先确认这些部位是否被重复计入或误扩。: Lift shafts and equipment floors on upper levels usually account for the largest share; when verifying, check first whether these parts have been counted twice or wrongly expanded.
map.：甲套内 90 ㎡、乙套内 120 ㎡，系数 18.3% → 甲摊 16.5 ㎡: : unit A has an internal area of 90 m2 and unit B 120 m2, and with a coefficient of 18.3% the allocated share is 16.5 m2 for A and 22.0 m2 for B. The difference comes from the differing internal areas, which reflects the logic of allocating by area.
map.：电梯井 500 ㎡、楼梯间 350 ㎡、大堂 250 ㎡，套内总面积 6000: : lift shafts 500 m2, stairwells 350 m2 and a lobby 250 m2 against a total internal area of 6000 m2 give a total shared area of 1100 m2 and a coefficient of 18.3%; the lift shaft at 45.5% is the largest item.
